extName.message: Free Game Claimer: Epic, Steam, GOG, Prime
extName.description: Extension name in the browser's extension list and on the store pages. At most 45 characters (addons.mozilla.org limit). Keep "Free Game Claimer" and the store names in English.

extDescription.message: Automatically claim free games from Epic Games Store, Steam, GOG, IndieGala and Prime Gaming. Just stay signed in.
extDescription.description: Short description in the browser's extension list and on the store pages. At most 132 characters (Chrome Web Store limit). Keep the store names in English.

extActionTitle.description: Tooltip on the extension's toolbar button. The product name: keep it in English.

catalogLocale.description: Not shown. Set it to this file's folder name (for example de or pt_BR): it picks the plural rules for counts such as "3 games claimed".

headerClaimedCount_one.description: Popup header, under the extension name: how many games it has claimed so far. Form for counts your language treats as singular.

headerClaimedCount_other.description: Popup header, under the extension name: how many games it has claimed so far. Form for all other counts.
